Name: Calm Earth
Description: With a disciplined gesture and stalwart word, you calm the earth in a 60-foot cube centred on a point within range for the duration. In the area, a rockslide grinds to a halt, ground tremors are soothed, and the effects of earth-based spells of a lower level than this spell, such as the earthen uppercut spell, are prevented and suppressed.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the level of earth-based spells suppressed by this spell increases.
Sourcebook: Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms
